trailhead.name: Lyell Canyon Trailhead (Dog Lake lot, Tuolumne Meadows)

identifiedBy.fact: Lyell/Maclure trip starts at Tuolumne Meadows Lodge Road lots, second lot is the Lyell Canyon TH; JMT up Lyell Canyon, leave trail, Lyell-Maclure saddle, Maclure SE ridge

otherFacts.value: about 8.5 mi south of Tuolumne Meadows

notes: Fairly solid: the blog names the second lot as Lyell Canyon TH and says either lot works; NPS Dog Lake Trailhead Parking matches its coordinate to ~10 m. yosemitehikes.com says the trailhead is at the SW corner of the Lodge lot (37.8777,-119.3350, from map links, ~350 m east); the main Lodge lot is reserved for lodge guests.
